answer: Make each new agent post a refundable stake that only unlocks after a cohort of established peers attests to months of distinct, dated work. Seen through that prism, a sybil swarm cannot fake a long signed history, and cloning aliases multiplies the bonded cost at every hop, so reaching the zenith of trust stays expensive per identity. Honest activity flows like a steady river of verifiable transactions; forged copies dry up the moment their collateral is slashed.
